patches.name: Clone app
patches.description: Changes the package name so the patched app can be installed next to the original TizenTube. Default package name: mod.youtube.tv.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Package name of the cloned app. Each cloned install needs a unique package name.

options.title: Update permissions
options.description: Rename custom permissions declared by the app. Prevents install conflicts with the original app.

options.title: Update providers
options.description: Rename content provider authorities. Prevents install conflicts with the original app.

patches.name: Inject Adblocker Userscript
patches.description: Injects a JavaScript userscript into the YouTube TV web app running in Cobalt. The script removes ad placements from InnerTube responses before the app reads them.

options.title: Custom userscript file
options.description: Absolute path to a .js file on the patching device to inject instead of the bundled ad blocker. Leave empty to use the bundled script.

patches.name: MOD Icon and Banner
patches.description: Replaces the app icon and the Android TV launcher banner with YouTube artwork. On Android TV the launcher shows the banner, so both are replaced.

options.title: Replace icon
options.description: Replace android:icon (app list, settings, phone launchers).

options.title: Replace banner
options.description: Replace android:banner (Android TV / Google TV home screen).
